title: Spinor moving frame, type II superparticle quantization, hidden $SU(8)$ symmetry of linearized 10D supergravity, and superamplitudes
summary: A covariant quantization of type IIB and type IIA superparticles in their spinor moving frame formulation reveals the hidden $SU(8)$ symmetry of the linearized type II supergravity. It acts on auxiliary variables parameterizing the possible choices of complex structures which is necessary to arrive at the realization of the quantum state vector as an analytic on-shell superfield, the one-particle counterpart of analytical superamplitudes for type IIB and type IIA supergravity multiplets. The description of the type IIA supergraity multiplet in terms of an analytic on-shell superfield is then…
